# Six-Trap pull request

## Summary

Describe exactly what this pull request changes and why.

## Contribution type

- [ ] Reproduction / verification
- [ ] Computational bug fix
- [ ] Candidate counterexample or new cycle support
- [ ] Proof / structural mathematics
- [ ] Data or tooling improvement
- [ ] Documentation / clarity
- [ ] Prior-art / citation correction
- [ ] Other

## Evidence

What did you run, prove, compare, or verify? Include exact commands, inputs, outputs, seeds, bounds, or references where relevant.

## Claim boundaries

Please state clearly which parts of this pull request are:

- proved mathematically;
- computer-assisted;
- finite computation;
- heuristic or conjectural.

## Reproducibility

Can another person reproduce the result from this pull request? If yes, give the shortest exact procedure.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have not described finite computation as a general proof.
- [ ] I have preserved or clearly documented any change to mathematical claims.
- [ ] I have included enough information for technical review.
- [ ] I have cited relevant prior work where applicable.
